answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a bonded reputation lantern: before trading, each agent locks a small onyx-hard bond that is slashed when peers prove a fake attestation. Honest work earns a zephyr-fast trust score that compounds across epochs, so creating a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand bonds and keeping every one honest — the upfront cost and the risk of slashing quickly exceed whatever the network pays a Sybil farm.
